event_name: September 2024 Vijayawada Prakasam Barrage Record Flood
notes: Highest discharge in 50 years at Prakasam Barrage; intense inundation in Ajit Singh Nagar, Vijayawada.

districts_affected: Alluri Sitharama Raju, East Godavari, Konaseema, Eluru
notes: Third warning signal hoisted for 5 days; entire Konaseema lanka villages inundated.

districts_affected: Krishna, Guntur, East Godavari, West Godavari
notes: Deep depression over Bay of Bengal caused unprecedented October catchment runoff.
Almatti and Srisailam full storage release downstream to Prakasam Barrage.
Historical benchmark flood for Godavari basin flood hazard zonation.
